vo: One skillet, dinner in twenty-six minutes.
Tonight: lemon herb pork chops with garlic spinach.
You need four pork chops, fresh thyme, baby spinach, two lemons, garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Pat the chops dry and season them with salt, pepper and chopped thyme.
Sear them six minutes a side until they hit one forty-five inside, then let them rest.
Same pan: garlic, then the spinach until it wilts. Squeeze the lemon over everything and serve.
